messages:
Ana (Growth): Need a micro sprint for launch visuals — tiny scope this time: 1 hero (1200x628), 2 social tiles (1080x1080) with A/B copy, and a printable 1-page sales PDF. Benchmark visual = single sparkline + one cost delta. Deadline: Thu EOD.
Dev (PM): Prioritize hero + one social tile variant for paid. Keep claims conservative, legal will want source notes.
Riley (Design): Copy tone? Also confirm whether hero needs light/dark variants.
Ana (Growth): Tone: technical-friendly. Hero both light and dark please. CTA: "Register". Tagline: "Serve better LLMs  lower latency, lower cost."
Riley (Design): Will do. I'll make 2 hero comps (clean + data-focused) and two social layouts. I'll include alt-text drafts and one-line captions for X and LinkedIn.
l10n-bot: Localization request received: Create separate Figma pages for EN/FR/DE, provide CSV with keys. Plan for +25% text expansion for DE.
Claire (Legal): Heads up: footer text required: "\u00a9 2026 Redwood Inference. All rights reserved." If partner logos are included on the 1-pager get written permission. Also add small footnote area for benchmark source.
Dev (PM): Export naming: `launch/servebetter/<asset>-<variant>-<size>-v1.<ext>`. Example: `launch/servebetter/hero-data-1200x628-v1.png`
Riley (Design): Accessibility: colorblind-safe palette for charts, 4.5:1 contrast for body copy, min 16px when scaled to 1080x1080. Will include spec sheet.
Ana (Growth): UTM table please: campaign=serve-better-2026; source=paid_social|email|partner; content=heroA|heroB. Include mapping for CRM lead queues.
Riley (Design): Timeline: hero comps by Tue noon PT, first exports Wed, full handoff Thu EOD with Figma link, CSV copy table, alt-texts, and export manifest. Will tag @marketing when hero PNG/GIF is uploaded. :sparkles:
